name: Mahé · Seychelles
tagline: Granite boulders and the world's most beautiful beaches
summary: The Seychelles are granite islands in the Indian Ocean with beaches framed by giant boulders. Base on Mahé to explore Victoria and Morne Seychellois, then ferry to Praslin's Vallée de Mai and La Digue's famous Anse Source d'Argent.
seasonNote: Warm all year. April-May and October-November are calmest between monsoons.
arrival: Seychelles International Airport is on Mahé, 15 minutes from Victoria.
gettingAround: Buses and rental cars on Mahé; ferries to Praslin and La Digue; bikes on La Digue.
cashTip: Seychelles uses rupees, but most tourist prices are quoted in euros; cards work widely. Prices here are in euros.
foodTip: Creole fish curry, grilled octopus and breadfruit chips.
buyTip: Coco de mer souvenirs (licensed) and local vanilla.
